key.lightframe.spawn_test_light: Spawn test light in front of player
lightframe.config.title: LightFrame Settings
lightframe.config.enable_rgb.tooltip: Master switch for the RGB colored lighting engine.
lightframe.config.quality.tooltip: LOW: fast block sampling, MEDIUM: standard interpolation, HIGH: extra smooth.
lightframe.config.boost_vanilla.tooltip: Feeds luminance into vanilla block light so colored lights illuminate the dark.
lightframe.config.gameplay_lighting.tool: If false, the light boost is client-side only (mobs can still spawn in dark areas).
lightframe.config.tint_strength.tooltip: Intensity of colored hue applied to world blocks.
lightframe.config.max_sources.tooltip: Maximum simultaneous colored light sources in the world.
lightframe.config.max_radius.tooltip: Maximum light propagation radius in blocks.
lightframe.config.max_rebuild.tooltip: Maximum chunk sections scheduled for re-rendering per client tick.
lightframe.config.tint_entities.tooltip: Applies colored lighting tint to players, mobs, and items.
lightframe.config.entity_directional.too: Calculates directional diffuse shading so the side of the entity facing the light is illuminated.
lightframe.config.tint_block_entities.to: Applies colored lighting tint to chests, signs, and other tile entities.
lightframe.config.enable_bloom.tooltip: Renders a soft, atmospheric colored aura around bright light sources.
lightframe.config.bloom_intensity.toolti: Controls the brightness and spread of the atmospheric bloom aura.
lightframe.config.shader_dynamic.tooltip: Keeps feeding dynamic luminance into block light when Iris shaders are active.
lightframe.config.debug_mode.tooltip: Enables the on-screen debug HUD and source bounding box visualization (Keybind: K).
lightframe.config.reset.tooltip: Restores all settings to their recommended default values.
